about.title: About me
about.lede: Hello, my name is Ioulietta Refene and I am a certified massage therapist.
about.p1: I come from Greece, where I studied Holistic Massage at Natural Health Science in Athens. Since 2009, I have been working in the field, continuously developing my approach through experience and further training.
about.p2: In my work, I combine techniques such as Swedish massage, deep tissue massage, myofascial release and neuromuscular therapy, adapting each session to the needs of the body — whether you are looking for relaxation or more focused, therapeutic work.
about.p3: Since 2024, I have been living and working in Lund, Sweden as a massage therapist, and in 2026 I founded Let Us Massage — a space dedicated to relaxation, well-being and quality body care.
about.p4: I am a certified medicinsk massageterapeut and a member of Kroppsterapeuterna (member no. 36786). The business is also fully insured, ensuring a safe and professional environment for every session.
about.quote: I love my job. Helping people feel better and healthier is the greatest reward.
about.credentials: Member of Kroppsterapeuterna · No. 36786 · Fully insured

techniques.title: Techniques
techniques.subtitle: Methods adapted to your body's needs
techniques.intro: Each session combines different techniques depending on what your body needs. Here are the methods that form the foundation of my work.

items.name: Swedish Massage
items.description: Swedish massage is one of the most widely used techniques and forms the foundation of many relaxation and wellness treatments. Gentle to medium pressure with long flowing strokes, kneading and rhythmic movements that release muscle tension and improve circulation.

items.name: Deep Tissue Massage
items.description: A focused technique designed to target deeper layers of muscle and chronic tension. Slow, deliberate strokes and firm pressure that work with muscles, tendons and fascia to release tight areas and restore mobility.

items.name: Myofascial Release
items.description: A gentle, targeted technique that works with the body's connective tissue (fascia) to reduce tension and improve mobility. Slow, sustained pressure and gentle stretching that allows the body to gradually relax and restore balance.
benefits: Reduces tension in muscles and fascia

items.name: Neuromuscular Therapy
items.description: An advanced approach focused on the connection between the muscular and nervous systems to relieve pain and improve body function. Combines deep tissue techniques with movement-based therapy to address underlying causes.

items.name: Trigger Point Therapy
items.description: A focused technique that targets specific tension points — "knots" — in muscle tissue. Sustained, direct pressure on these sensitive points helps muscle fibers release and relax, often combined with myofascial release and deep tissue techniques.

items.body: Ioulietta Refene is a certified medicinsk massageterapeut and member of Kroppsterapeuterna since 2009. Trained in Swedish massage, deep tissue, myofascial release, neuromuscular therapy, prenatal massage, connective tissue techniques, sports massage and anatomy.

items.title: Individualized sessions
items.body: There is no one-size-fits-all massage. Pressure, techniques and approach are adapted to muscle condition, stress levels, mobility and whether you need relaxation or deeper work.

items.title: Ideal for modern lifestyles
items.body: Sessions are especially suitable for office workers, neck and back tension, tension headaches, poor posture, and the everyday stress that just needs to release.

items.title: Safety and professionalism
items.body: Fully insured business operating under Kroppsterapeuternas standards. Calm environment, full privacy, proper health history assessment and a professional approach from the very first moment.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your session

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: Easily online through Bokadirekt — choose your preferred service, length and an available time.

items.q: What happens during the first session?
items.a: We take a few minutes to discuss your needs, lifestyle and any tension. You complete a short health history form so I can safely adapt the treatment to any injuries, medications or medical conditions.
Yes. Klassisk Massage and Relaxmassage are eligible for friskvårdsbidrag (max 1000 SEK per visit under Swedish rules). Massageterapi has a therapeutic focus and is not covered by friskvård.

items.q: Which treatment is right for me?
items.a: Relaxmassage for stress and relaxation. Klassisk Massage for preventive wellness if you have a sedentary job. Massageterapi for pain, stiffness and reduced mobility. Prenatal Massage adapted for pregnancy from the second trimester.

Pressure is always adapted to your comfort. Deeper techniques may feel intense or briefly tender — but never overwhelming or unsafe. Modern massage no longer follows the idea that 'good massage must hurt'.

items.q: Is it normal to feel sore afterwards?
items.a: Yes — mild soreness for 1–2 days is common after deeper work. It's usually followed by improved mobility and a lighter feeling. Drink plenty of water and avoid intense activity for the rest of the day.

items.q: Can I get a massage during pregnancy?
items.a: Yes, from the second trimester onwards if your pregnancy is uncomplicated and you have your doctor's approval. The session uses safe positions and gentle Swedish techniques adapted for pregnancy.
Comfortable clothing. During the massage, areas that aren't being treated are always covered with towels for warmth, comfort and privacy.
Avoid heavy meals 1–2 hours before, stay well hydrated, avoid excessive alcohol or caffeine, and a warm shower beforehand can help your body relax more easily.

items.q: When should I avoid a massage?
items.a: Fever, infection, acute illness, thrombosis, contagious skin conditions, acute inflammation, recent fractures or major injuries. Heart conditions, cancer treatment, anticoagulants, high-risk pregnancy, osteoporosis or recent surgery require medical approval.

relax.intro: Relax Massage is a gentle and calming treatment designed to help your body release tension and your mind slow down. It is based on Swedish massage techniques, using soft and rhythmic movements to create a deep sense of relaxation and overall wellbeing.
relax.what: A pure relaxation treatment based on classic Swedish massage. Ideal when you feel stressed, tired, or simply need time to unwind.
relax.how: Light massage techniques are applied to reduce stress and mental fatigue, relax tight muscles, improve circulation and support the body's natural balance. The movements are smooth and continuous, allowing your body to relax naturally without intense pressure.
whoFor: People experiencing stress or mental fatigue
Those with tension in neck and shoulders
Anyone looking for a gentle, relaxing massage

sessions.name: Relax Massage 30 min
sessions.description: Focuses on the upper body (neck, shoulders, back, arms). Perfect for relieving tension from desk work or daily stress.

sessions.name: Relax Massage 60 min
sessions.description: A full-body massage session. Provides deeper relaxation and a complete wellness experience.

relax.important: Eligible for friskvårdsbidrag according to Swedish wellness regulations.

klassisk.intro: Klassisk Massage is a more dynamic and preventive massage designed for people with sedentary work and everyday muscle tension. The goal is to support muscular wellbeing, improve mobility, and help prevent tension caused by modern working life.
klassisk.what: A preventive wellness treatment combining Swedish techniques, deep tissue style work and myofascial release. Suitable for friskvård (corporate wellness) and can be used through benefits such as Benify and Epassi.
klassisk.how: Adapted techniques are used depending on your body's needs: Swedish massage techniques, deep tissue style work and myofascial release techniques. These methods help release deeper layers of muscle tension, improve circulation, and reduce stiffness caused by prolonged sitting and repetitive strain.
whoFor: People with poor or strained posture
Those spending long hours in front of a computer
Anyone wanting to prevent tension in neck, shoulders, and back
People looking to maintain physical wellbeing in daily life
benefits: Lighter and more relaxed body feeling
Prevention of stiffness from sedentary lifestyle

sessions.name: 30 min Klassisk Massage
sessions.description: Focused treatment for neck, shoulders, and upper back. Perfect for quick relief from office-related tension.

sessions.name: 45 min Klassisk Massage
sessions.description: The most balanced and popular option. Focuses on neck, shoulders, shoulder blades, and upper back, with optional work on the lower back depending on your needs.

sessions.name: 60 min Klassisk Massage (Premium)
sessions.description: Full-body session with focus areas based on your needs. A more complete treatment aimed at improving mobility, releasing tension, and supporting long-term physical wellbeing.

klassisk.important: This service is strictly preventive and wellbeing-focused (friskvård) and is not a medical or therapeutic treatment. Eligible for friskvårdsbidrag (max 1000 SEK per visit).

massageterapi.intro: Massageterapi is an advanced therapeutic massage approach focused on reducing pain, improving mobility, and restoring proper musculoskeletal function. It is not a relaxation massage, but a targeted treatment that works deeply with areas of tension, pain, and restricted movement.
massageterapi.what: A therapeutic treatment combining specialized techniques: Swedish Massage (to prepare tissues and improve circulation), Deep Tissue Massage (to release deep muscular tension), Neuromuscular Therapy (to restore neuromuscular balance), Trigger Point Therapy (to treat localized pain points) and Myofascial Release (to release connective tissue restrictions).
massageterapi.how: This integrated approach allows for a holistic treatment that addresses both symptoms and underlying causes of dysfunction. Enough time is dedicated to ensure the treatment is not rushed or superficial. The approach is based on the close relationship between the muscular and nervous systems. The intensity is always adapted to your body and individual needs, guided through communication.
whoFor: Neck pain and cervical tension ("tech neck" / whiplash-related strain)
Upper, mid, and lower back pain / chronic lumbago
Piriformis syndrome, thoracic outlet syndrome, shoulder impingement
benefits: Relief from muscle pain and chronic tension
A more functional, balanced, and free-moving body

sessions.name: 45 min Massageterapi
sessions.description: Focused treatment for neck, shoulders, and upper back. Ideal for targeted relief from pain and tension.

sessions.name: 60 min Massageterapi (Premium)
sessions.description: Extends to the back, lower back, and hips for a more complete therapeutic approach.

sessions.name: 75 min Massageterapi (Premium)
sessions.description: Full-body treatment with balanced focus across all areas for overall recovery and function.

sessions.name: 90 min Massageterapi (Premium)
sessions.description: The most complete therapeutic session with deep and detailed work throughout the entire body.

massageterapi.important: Massageterapi has a therapeutic focus and is not covered by friskvård. The intensity is always adapted to your body and comfort level.

prenatal.intro: Prenatal Massage (pregnancy massage) is a gentle and adapted massage designed specifically for the needs of women during pregnancy. As the body changes, increased pressure is often felt in the lower back, shoulders, hips, and legs.
prenatal.what: A pregnancy-adapted treatment based on gentle Swedish massage techniques, carefully adapted to ensure safety for both mother and baby. The session is designed with safety and comfort as the top priority.
prenatal.how: The massage is performed in supportive positions: side-lying (the safest and most comfortable position during pregnancy) and semi-reclined (with proper support and alignment). Pillows are used to fully support the body, reduce pressure on the spine, and allow deep relaxation. The treatment focuses on back and lower back, neck and shoulders, hips and pelvic area, and arms and legs. The abdominal area is not included.
whoFor: Experiencing tension in the back, hips, or legs
Want to relax and support their body during pregnancy
Looking for a calm and safe wellbeing experience
benefits: Relief from tension in back, lower back, and legs
Support for posture as the body changes
Reduced stress and improved sleep quality
A sense of relaxation and connection with the body

sessions.name: 60 min Prenatal Massage
sessions.description: Gentle full-body treatment in side-lying or semi-reclined position with full pillow support.

prenatal.important: Sessions are available from the 2nd trimester onwards. Doctor's approval is recommended before booking. The massage is not performed in case of pregnancy complications. Recommended frequency: 2nd trimester once a week or every 10 days, 3rd trimester up to twice a week depending on needs.

svensk-massage.intro: Swedish massage is one of the most widely used massage techniques and forms the foundation of many relaxation and wellness treatments.
svensk-massage.what: This technique uses gentle to medium pressure to promote relaxation and improve blood circulation. It includes long flowing strokes, kneading, and rhythmic movements that help release muscle tension and calm the nervous system.
svensk-massage.how: The pressure is always adapted to your needs, creating a balanced experience between relaxation and therapeutic effect. The strokes are flowing and rhythmic, creating deep relaxation while stimulating circulation.

deep-tissue.intro: Deep tissue massage is a focused technique designed to target deeper layers of muscles and chronic tension in the body.
deep-tissue.what: A method working with deeper connective tissues, including muscles, tendons, and fascia. Especially beneficial for people experiencing tension from prolonged sitting, physical activity, stress, or past injuries.
deep-tissue.how: Slow, deliberate strokes and firm pressure are used to release tight areas and restore mobility. The pressure is always adjusted to your comfort level, and open communication is encouraged. Deep breathing helps the body relax and enhance the effectiveness of the treatment.
deep-tissue.afterSession: You may experience mild soreness for 1–3 days after the session. This typically fades and is followed by improved mobility and a sense of release in the body.

myofascial-release.intro: Myofascial Release is a gentle, targeted technique that works with the body's connective tissue (fascia) to reduce tension and improve mobility.
myofascial-release.what: Fascia is a continuous network of connective tissue that surrounds and supports muscles, joints, and organs. When it becomes tight due to stress, injury, or inactivity, it can restrict movement and create discomfort.
myofascial-release.how: This technique uses slow, sustained pressure and gentle stretching to release restrictions in the fascia. Instead of forceful manipulation, it allows the body to gradually relax and restore balance. Sustained, gentle pressure can release tension in connective tissues, improve mobility and support natural alignment.
myofascial-release.afterSession: The treatment is typically slow and calming. You may feel a gentle release or softening in areas of tension, rather than strong pressure or pain.
benefits: Reduces tension in muscles and fascia

nmt.intro: Neuromuscular Therapy is an advanced, targeted approach that focuses on the connection between the muscular and nervous systems to relieve pain and improve body function.
nmt.what: NMT combines deep tissue techniques with movement-based therapy to address the underlying causes of muscular tension and dysfunction.
nmt.how: A session may include posture and movement assessment, passive and active mobilization techniques, Trigger Point Therapy, myofascial release and Deep Tissue Massage. The body functions as an interconnected system where muscles and nerves constantly interact. NMT works to restore this balance by targeting the source of the issue, not just the symptoms.

trigger-point.intro: Trigger Point Therapy is a focused massage technique that targets specific areas of muscle tension to relieve pain and restore natural movement.
trigger-point.what: Trigger points are small, tight areas within muscle tissue, often described as "knots." They can develop due to stress, repetitive movement, poor posture, or overuse, and may cause local or referred pain in other parts of the body.
trigger-point.how: This technique applies sustained, direct pressure to these sensitive points, helping the muscle fibers release and relax. It is often combined with myofascial release and deep tissue techniques for more effective results. Applying pressure to trigger points can reduce muscle tightness, improve blood flow and support natural recovery.
trigger-point.afterSession: You may feel intensity or tenderness during the treatment, especially in sensitive areas. This is normal and usually followed by a sense of relief and improved movement.
